reviews.title: Good Variety, Bad Functionality
reviews.text:
Good stuff: title variety is much more diverse than alternatives like shueisha’s manga plus. Subscription is quite cheap, too!

Bad stuff: you need a subscription to read anything past the first three chapters, no free first viewing like shueisha. Even when you do sign up, what you can read is rate-limited to 100 chapters every 24 hours, across all series - so you’d better like what you click on, or else you’ve wasted your quota! Chapter loading is also slightly buggy, requiring a full reload if any pages fail to download, rather than retrying each page.
